plan: Fix the panel.py false positives by masking comments and string literals before matching, so a SQL keyword inside a comment or a docstring stops being a HIGH finding.
refuted_by: The planted selftest defect IS SQL inside a string literal: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' + id). Masking string literals would have turned the oracle green on a real injection, which is weakening an oracle to make a change pass.
evidence: tools/review/panel.py cmd_selftest, the planted src/state/api.ts row; tests/test_panel_sql_concat.py::test_planted_selftest_defect_still_fires
replan: Require SQL STRUCTURE and DYNAMIC ASSEMBLY as two independent lookaheads, so the discriminator is FROM/INTO/SET rather than quote position. Comments were never the mechanism.
class: the fix that would have disabled the oracle it was fixing

plan: Assess the deck's overflow, print path and font fallback by reading the CSS, since the rules are all present in one 11KB stylesheet.
refuted_by: Rendering it in Chrome over CDP overturned three conclusions in four minutes. Slide 6 does not clip at 1366 or 1920 (the written claim that no laptop can read it was wrong); the element that actually gets cut is the .takeaway conclusion box on slides 9, 10 and 16; and Iowan Old Style measures identically to a bogus font name, so the serif silently falls back.
evidence: canvas text-width probe and per-slide scrollHeight over CDP on 127.0.0.1:9224; corrected in thesis_review_2026-07-31.md section II.1b
replan: Any claim about a rendered artifact stays inference until rendered. Run the artifact through a measurement function over all N states rather than reasoning about the source that generates them.
class: static reading of a source that only a runtime can answer
